$comment: Input for tools/build-manifest.mjs. Edit this, drop jars into pack/mods, run `npm run pack:build`, commit pack/manifest.json.
name: Vasya Family S1

selfHost.$comment: Mods that are not found on Modrinth are uploaded to this GitHub release (named by SHA-1) and downloaded from here.

resourcepacks.$comment: Zips in pack/resourcepacks, listed bottom to top (last = highest priority). 'enabled' packs are switched on the first time a player gets them; afterwards the player's own choice wins. Players can still add their own packs.

shaderpacks.$comment: Zips in pack/shaderpacks. Optional 'default' is selected in Iris the first time; 'enabled' decides whether shaders start on. No default = Iris installed, no shader picked.

overrides.$comment: Per-mod settings, keyed by mod id. optional/default/name/extraDownloads override what the tool detects.

libipn.$comment: Library for Inventory Profiles Next; always installed so it doesn't show as its own toggle.

music_disc_maker.$comment: CurseForge file 9560946 (not on Modrinth). Client & server.
